summary.prose: Adherence and functional-coverage reviews will inspect source in read-only reviewer sessions instead of judging implementation from symbol summaries alone. Both single-call and divided reviews will distinguish a source-demonstrated breach from an inability to verify behavior, retaining real defects while downgrading evidence gaps to LOW observations.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Fix approved ISSUE-47e2b81827433589: source-ground adherence and functional-coverage judges in single and divided review paths; missing evidence must be LOW unverified observation, proven omissions remain findings. Include regression tests and re-review b7a68147dcf72034 s4.

returns.meaning: Adherence/functional coverage use reviewer-session execution for every model call including judge, chunk, obligation gather, relation and reduction, preserving serial driver and existing limits.

errors.condition: Reviewer session unavailable or invocation/validation fails: existing pipeline failure/retry, never fabricated pass.

preconditions: Existing subject and snapshot contracts hold.
postconditions: Source-read instructions permit Read/Grep/Glob and read-only commands such as rg and sed for Codex; no writes or test execution.
Single/chunk/gather prompts explicitly identify summaries and NO_EVIDENCE as incomplete navigation evidence, never proof of absence.
Proven breaches require actual source location and explanation after checking relevant helpers; missing/unreadable/deleted/inadequate evidence is confidence observation and severity LOW.
Other review dimensions preserve existing execution.

Shared chunk and gather builders must opt out of their current summary-only and notes-are-whole-evidence instructions for these dimensions, including obligation, relation and reduction prompts; preserve citations and uncertainty during reduction.

dataModelChanges.details: Add optional source-inspection opt-in consumed only by the adapter; absent preserves compatibility. One spec owns many calls (1:N); adapter passes chosen execution to chunk and gather, each call routes through existing driver to exactly one read-only session. No persistence or public IPC schema changes. Explicitly update src/workflow/review-pipeline/adapters/code-review-chunk.ts and src/workflow/review-pipeline/adapters/code-review-gather.ts: opt-in-aware chunk, obligation, relation and reduction prompts must remove summary-only and closed-evidence assumptions, permit read-only source inspection, and preserve source citations and uncertainty through reductions. Other dimensions retain existing prompt behavior.

Require explicit confidence breach|observation in new model outputs. toResult normalizes observations to LOW; legacy missing confidence is conservatively LOW observation. Breach means source was inspected and demonstrated the specific omission/departure; message cites concrete source and limitation. This does not demote genuine partial implementations proven in source. Chunk notes retain source locations and uncertainty; gather rechecks source rather than converting an empty notes set to a breach. Existing changed-file and known-FR filters remain.

errorCases.scenario: Source unavailable, deleted or insufficient to establish the clause
errorCases.detection: Reviewer attempts source inspection and records missing/read-denied evidence or unresolved helper/context; absent chunk notes alone never establish absence.
errorCases.response: LOW observation identifying what could not be verified, not unimplemented expectation.
errorCases.userImpact: Review exposes evidence gap without false blocking defect.

errorCases.scenario: Session missing, timeout, invalid schema or provider failure
errorCases.detection: Existing driver detects unavailable runReviewSession, thrown invocation or failed output validation.
errorCases.response: Existing bounded retry and not-judged/failure behavior; never manufacture pass or implementation absence.
errorCases.userImpact: Explicit review failure or incomplete evidence.

errorCases.detection: Reviewer sees inconsistent source versus supplied summary or file change while tracing the clause.
errorCases.response: Identify inspected version and uncertainty; unresolved behavior is LOW observation, do not assert missing implementation from stale summaries.
errorCases.userImpact: User can rerun on stable tree.

edgeCases.expected: Retain appropriate HIGH/MED breach at real changed code location with approved expectation ref.
Gather inspects source before concluding; if still unverified, LOW observation.

edgeCases.input: Legacy finding with absent confidence or observation labeled HIGH
edgeCases.expected: Normalize to LOW observation; explicit source-demonstrated breach retains severity.

migration.stateBefore: s1 analyze adapter exploration and source inspection show structured completion calls on symbol summaries; adherence and functional-coverage gather infer unimplemented behavior from missing notes.
migration.stateAfter: Two dimensions opt into read-only source-inspecting reviewer sessions, source-proven breaches retain severity and evidence gaps become LOW observations on both pipeline paths.

migrationSteps.action: Add optional dimension source-inspection selection and propagate existing reviewer execution/limits through all generated calls.
Update both dimensions' single and divided prompts, confidence schemas and conservative observation normalization; add regressions.

Build and validate; run mandatory Story review and targeted s4 re-review on updated runtime. Do not silently restart or deploy an installed daemon; if the connected runtime is stale, use isolated temporary-home runtime or document the exact blocked live verification.

migration.backwardCompat: No public IPC, DB or provider interface changes. Other dimensions retain structured execution. Existing CR records remain historical; no rewrite or automatic approval. Legacy missing-confidence output is normalized LOW observation when processed by revised dimensions.

alternativesConsidered.name: Read-only reviewer sessions with explicit evidence outcomes
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Reuse existing reviewer-session execution for the two dimensions and require source checks.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Opt adherence and functional coverage into existing read-only reviewer-session execution for single, chunk and gather calls. Prompts require inspecting changed source with platform-appropriate read commands, recording source-grounded evidence versus unverified observations, and never inferring absence from summaries. Gather may read source to resolve gaps. Preserve existing chunk orchestration.
pros: Reuses existing CLI/Ollama reviewer capability and driver
No raw file dumps or context-size expansion
Checks helpers and tests when source alone needs context
cons: Live session readings must be explicitly prompted and regression tested
Longer model calls; source can change during a review, which must be reported if detected

alternativesConsidered.name: Frozen source evidence atoms
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Snapshot changed files and feed line-numbered source through chunked material.
alternativesConsidered.approach: Extend grounding with exact line-numbered changed source, provenance and unavailable status; prepare source snapshots and divide into bounded source atoms while retaining summaries as context. Judge and gather consume source evidence rather than live reads.
cons: Substantial changes to material atoms and chunk sizing
Raw source payload conflicts with structured-context project rule unless carefully excerpted
Cross-file helper context still needs expansion
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Larger atom and grounding redesign with source-dump tension; no need to introduce it for this defect.
